waitForReady.description: Wait until the BASIC READY. prompt is visible before returning. A timeout is reported as ready=false, not as an error.

readyTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for READY. when waitForReady is true (1-120000 ms).

name.description: Unique task name (letters, digits, spaces, '_', '-', '.'; must not start with '.' or a space). Limits depend on op.

operation.description: Operation name: read, write, read_screen or menu_button (read_memory and write_memory are aliases). write requires arguments.address and arguments.bytes.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations (1 to 100000; omit for indefinite)

includeTimeline.description: Include the tail of the event timeline.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of span and timeline entries to return.

description:
System operations available via the c64_system tool.

Operations:
- pause [write]: Pause the machine until resumed. Required inputs: none.
- resume [write]: Resume CPU execution after a pause. Required inputs: none.
- reset [write]: Issue a soft reset without cutting power. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- reboot [destructive]: Trigger a firmware reboot to recover from faults. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- poweroff [c64u, vice] [destructive]: Shut down C64U/U64 or quit VICE. U2-family hardware cannot power off. On C64U/U64 the machine cannot be restarted by software afterwards: power must be restored at the outlet, and it starts by itself only if automatic startup on power restoration is enabled. Required inputs: none.
- power_cycle [destructive]: Return the active backend to a fresh state. C64U/U64 Tool Menu verification requires machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+); U2-family reboots through REST. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- menu [c64u, u2] [write]: Toggle the Ultimate menu button for navigation. Required inputs: none.
- read_menu_screen [c64u, u2]: Read the active Ultimate menu's raw character and colour matrix through machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64/U2 3.15+). Required inputs: none.
- start_task [write]: Start a named background task that runs on an interval. Required inputs: name, operation. Optional inputs: arguments, intervalMs, maxIterations.
- stop_task [write]: Stop a specific background task and clear its timer. Required inputs: name.
- stop_all_tasks [write]: Stop every running background task and persist state. Required inputs: none.
- list_tasks: List known background tasks with status metadata. Required inputs: none.
- performance_report: Summarize diagnostics spans and tool latencies from the current or latest MCP session. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: scope, includeTimeline, maxEntries.
